mahant_software.name: Mahant Software
mahant_software.tagline: Custom Software, Mobile Apps & Digital Solutions
mahant_software.bio: Mahant Software is a modern IT development studio specializing in high-performance web applications, mobile apps, digital business cards, and end-to-end automation for growing businesses.

services.title: Custom Web Applications
services.description: High speed, modern, mobile-responsive web platforms, portals and eCommerce solutions.

services.title: Mobile App Development
services.description: Cross-platform Android & iOS applications with clean UX, offline sync and cloud integration.

services.title: Digital Visiting Cards & NFC
services.description: Smart paperless business cards with instant WhatsApp contact saving & QR code integration.

services.title: Business Automation & ERP
services.description: Custom billing, inventory, client management and workflow automation software.

services.title: SEO & Digital Branding
services.description: Search engine visibility, Google My Business optimization and professional brand identities.

testimonials.author: Bhavesh Patel
testimonials.text: Mahant Software delivered our website and digital card on time. Our clients love the 1-click WhatsApp order feature!

testimonials.author: Rajesh Sharma
testimonials.text: Exceptional service and quick response. The digital card and quotation system saved our team hours every week.

testimonials.author: Ankit Mehta
testimonials.text: Super professional team. Having a QR code digital card makes networking at expos and trade fairs effortless.
